theorems.name: Submission.constancy_approx_identity_iteratedFDeriv_tendstoUniformly
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : Eucl n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → ∀ (ψ : ℕ → Eucl n → ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, Continuous (ψ k)) → (∀ k x, 0 ≤ ψ k x) → (∀ k, ∫ x, ψ k x ∂volume = 1) → (∀ k, tsupport (ψ k) ⊆ closedBall 0 (r k)) → Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ q : ℕ, TendstoUniformly (fun k x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ q (convolution (ψ k) b (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) x) (fun x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ q b x) atTop
